description: This file contains unit tests for the BbrSender congestion control algorithm in QUIC, including setup, transfer scenarios, state transitions, and regression tests.

classes.name: BbrSenderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for BbrSender congestion control, setting up network scenarios, running transfers, and verifying state transitions.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads regression data if needed, and seeds random generator.

methods.name: CreateDefaultSetup
methods.description: Sets up a network with a bottleneck and large buffers to simulate ideal conditions.

methods.name: CreateSmallBufferSetup
methods.description: Sets up a network with smaller buffers to test loss scenarios.

methods.name: CreateCompetitionSetup
methods.description: Sets up a network with two competing senders for the same bottleneck.

methods.name: CreateBbrVsBbrSetup
methods.description: Sets up a competition between two BBR flows.

methods.name: EnableAggregation
methods.description: Enables packet aggregation on the network path.

methods.name: DoSimpleTransfer
methods.description: Runs a transfer of specified size within a deadline.

methods.name: DriveOutOfStartup
methods.description: Simulates network conditions to exit startup phase.

methods.name: SendBursts
methods.description: Sends bursts of data with waits in between.

methods.name: SetConnectionOption
methods.description: Configures connection options for different test scenarios.
